fields.title: Miami Life (Miami, Florida), Volume 5, Number 10 (March 24, 1928)
creator: Wen R. Phillips
subject: Police misconduct
Grand jury investigations
City government
Miami (Fla.) politics
Municipal bands
Public schools
Child welfare
Public health
Bootlegging
Elections
fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local reporting on a sensational police investigation in Miami, criticizing city commissioners for inaction and discussing indictments involving Chief of Police H. Leslie Quigg and alleged jail torture. Additional pieces address a dispute over hiring an outside band versus forming a Miami Municipal Band, efforts to provide midday meals for schoolchildren, concerns about unsanitary mattress resale practices, local political campaigns and candidates, preparations for a major Shrine convention and city beautification, sports and entertainment notices, and assorted local briefs and advertisements.
